description: The date N whole calendar days after a date (exclusive counting: the start date is day 0). Omit date for today in tz. For working days use business_days; for the gap between two dates use days_between.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

days.description: Whole calendar days to add. Negative counts backwards.

tz.description: IANA timezone that defines "today" (e.g. Africa/Kampala). Default UTC.

name: add_days

receipt.description: Auditable receipt: inputs, timezone, convention, workweek, holiday calendar, exclusions, versions, stable result ID

title: Add calendar days to a date
